# ggelato

`ggelato` (Grammar of Graphics for Exploring and Layering Aggregated
Time series) provides interactive graphics for hierarchical and grouped
time series. Plots are specified with a layered grammar in the style of
`ggplot2`. Each plot includes a hierarchy widget for selecting,
reordering and filtering the levels of the structure.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN with

``` r

install.packages("ggelato")
```

or the development version from GitHub with

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("yvesypher/ggelato")
```

## Example

``` r

library(ggelato)
library(fabletools)
library(feasts)

tourism_hts <- aus_tourism |>
  aggregate_key((State / Region) * Purpose, Trips = sum(Trips))

tourism_features <- tourism_hts |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl)

gig(tourism_features,
    gig_aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_year)) +
  geom_features() +
  hierarchy((State / Region) * Purpose)
```

[`geom_stl()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_stl.md)
displays STL decompositions and
[`geom_sunburst()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_sunburst.md)
displays the aggregation structure. Several plots can be coordinated
with the [fridge](https://github.com/yvesypher/fridge) package. See
[`vignette("ggelato")`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/articles/ggelato.md)
for a full introduction.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_hierarchy_hc()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/add_hierarchy_hc.md)
  : Add an interactive hierarchy widget to a highcharter plot
- [`add_hierarchy_plotly()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/add_hierarchy_plotly.md)
  : Add an interactive hierarchy widget to a plotly plot
- [`as_gig_hierarchy()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/as_gig_hierarchy.md)
  : Coerce a structure string to a gig_hierarchy
- [`aus_tourism`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/aus_tourism.md)
  : Australian domestic overnight trips, 1998 Q1 to 2022 Q4
- [`geom_featuresOutput()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_features-shiny.md)
  [`renderGeomFeatures()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_features-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for geom_features()
- [`geom_features()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_features.md)
  : Feature-space scatter layer
- [`geom_stlOutput()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_stl-shiny.md)
  [`renderGeomStl()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_stl-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for geom_stl()
- [`geom_stl()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_stl.md)
  : STL decomposition layer
- [`geom_sunburstOutput()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_sunburst-shiny.md)
  [`renderGeomSunburst()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_sunburst-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for geom_sunburst()
- [`geom_sunburst()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/geom_sunburst.md)
  : Sunburst layer
- [`gig()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/gig.md) :
  Create a gig plot specification
- [`gig_aes()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/gig_aes.md)
  : Aesthetic mappings for gig plots
- [`gig_build()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/gig_build.md)
  : Build a gig plot into an htmlwidget
- [`hierarchy()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/hierarchy.md)
  : Aggregation structure of a hierarchical or grouped time series
- [`is_gig()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/is_gig.md)
  : Is this object a gig plot specification?
- [`is_gig_aes()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/is_gig_aes.md)
  : Is this object a gig aesthetic mapping?
- [`is_gig_hierarchy()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/is_gig_hierarchy.md)
  : Is this object a gig hierarchy specification?
- [`is_gig_layer()`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/is_gig_layer.md)
  : Is this object a gig layer?
- [`` `+`( ``*`<gig>`*`)`](https://yvesypher.github.io/ggelato/reference/plus-.gig.md)
  : Add a component to a gig plot
